reading: Consumers are feeling the pinch from the rising cost of protein.
Amarpreet Singh has been drinking protein shakes since he was 16.
Amarpreet says a 4.5kg bag of the whey protein he buys cost around £60 in 2020.
By last year, its price had gone up to £120.
Fourteen years later, shakes are still part of his routine, but they have become considerably more expensive.
Over the years, protein powders and shakes have attracted a much broader customer base.
Evie Lewis began using protein powder because she felt she wasn't getting enough protein in her diet.
At £32.99 for a 420g tub, Evie is feeling the high price.
She admits, "I've been rationing it and using less than what's suggested."
The growing appetite for protein is running up against a problem: supply has not kept pace.
Manufacturers say that increasing production takes time and is costly, as producing high-protein whey requires specialist processing and drying equipment.
Some companies are starting to adapt what they make by changing recipes or looking for cheaper sources of protein.
For students like Evie, managing on a much tighter budget, buying protein is a different story.
She says that now she is at university, protein is not a necessity right now.
One protein user explains, "If you're doing exercise and not taking any, you feel like you wouldn't be recovering properly."

vocabulary.definition: experiencing financial difficulty because you have less money than before
much or a lot; to a large degree
a regular way of doing things in a particular order
all the people who buy or use a particular product or service
controlling the amount of something that people can have or use, often because there is not enough of it
a strong desire or need for something, in this context, demand for protein products
moved or developed at the same speed as something else; to keep up
having or involving expert knowledge or training in a particular area
to change something or yourself to suit a new situation
something that you must have or do, or that is very important

entries.ja: 以前よりもお金が少なくなったため、金銭的な困難を経験していること。
entries.ko: 이전보다 돈이 적어서 재정적인 어려움을 겪는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 由于钱比以前少了而遇到经济困难。
entries.es: Experimentar dificultades económicas porque se tiene menos dinero que antes.
entries.pt-BR: Estar passando por dificuldades financeiras por ter menos dinheiro do que antes.

entries.ja: 大いに、または非常に多く；大幅に。
entries.zh-Hans: 很多或大量；在很大程度上。
entries.es: Mucho o en gran cantidad; en gran medida.
entries.pt-BR: Muito ou em grande quantidade; em grande grau.

entries.ja: 特定の順序で物事を定期的に行う方法。
entries.ko: 특정한 순서로 일을 정기적으로 하는 방식.
entries.zh-Hans: 以特定顺序定期做事情的方式。
entries.es: Una forma regular de hacer las cosas en un orden particular.
entries.pt-BR: Uma maneira regular de fazer as coisas em uma ordem específica.

entries.ja: 特定の製品やサービスを購入または利用するすべての人々。
entries.ko: 특정 제품이나 서비스를 구매하거나 사용하는 모든 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 所有购买或使用特定产品或服务的人。
entries.es: Todas las personas que compran o utilizan un producto o servicio en particular.
entries.pt-BR: Todas as pessoas que compram ou usam um produto ou serviço específico.

entries.ja: 何かの量が十分でないことが多いため、人々が持てる、または使える量を制限すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이 충분하지 않아서 사람들이 가질 수 있거나 사용할 수 있는 양을 통제하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 控制人们可以拥有或使用的某物的数量，通常是因为某物不足。
entries.es: Controlar la cantidad de algo que las personas pueden tener o usar, a menudo porque no hay suficiente.
entries.pt-BR: Controlar a quantidade de algo que as pessoas podem ter ou usar, muitas vezes porque não há o suficiente.

entries.ja: この文脈では、タンパク質製品に対する強い欲求や必要性、つまり需要。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 대한 강한 욕구 또는 필요성, 이 문맥에서는 단백질 제품에 대한 수요.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某物有强烈的渴望或需求，在此语境中指对蛋白质产品的需求。
entries.es: Un fuerte deseo o necesidad de algo, en este contexto, la demanda de productos proteicos.
entries.pt-BR: Um forte desejo ou necessidade de algo, neste contexto, a demanda por produtos proteicos.

entries.ja: 他のものと同じ速さで動いたり、発展したりしたこと；追いついたこと。
entries.ko: 다른 것과 같은 속도로 움직이거나 발전하는 것; 뒤처지지 않고 따라잡는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 以与他物相同的速度移动或发展；跟上。
entries.es: Moverse o desarrollarse a la misma velocidad que otra cosa; mantenerse al día.
entries.pt-BR: Mover-se ou desenvolver-se na mesma velocidade que outra coisa; acompanhar.

entries.ja: 特定の分野において専門的な知識や訓練を持っている、またはそれに関わる。
entries.ko: 특정 분야에서 전문적인 지식이나 훈련을 가지고 있거나 그것과 관련된.
entries.zh-Hans: 在特定领域拥有或涉及专业知识或培训的。
entries.es: Que tiene o implica conocimientos o formación especializados en un área particular.
entries.pt-BR: Que possui ou envolve conhecimento ou treinamento especializado em uma área específica.

entries.ja: 新しい状況に合わせて何かや自分自身を変えること。
entries.ko: 새로운 상황에 맞게 무엇인가나 자신을 바꾸는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 改变某物或自己以适应新的情况。
entries.es: Cambiar algo o a uno mismo para adaptarse a una nueva situación.
entries.pt-BR: Mudar algo ou a si mesmo para se adequar a uma nova situação.

entries.ja: 持っていなければならないもの、またはしなければならないこと、あるいは非常に重要なこと。
entries.ko: 반드시 가져야 하거나 해야 하는 것, 또는 매우 중요한 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 你必须拥有或做的事情，或者是非常重要的事情。
entries.es: Algo que uno debe tener o hacer, o que es muy importante.
entries.pt-BR: Algo que você deve ter ou fazer, ou que é muito importante.
